title: TPP Dynamic Warmup
author: Chris S.
desc: This dynamic warmup is designed to prepare the body for peak performance by elevating tissue temperature, increasing blood flow, and improving joint mobility. Through a progression of controlled movements and explosive drills, it activates key muscles and primes the nervous system for strength, speed, and power training. The warmup transitions from General Dynamics, focusing on mobility and muscle activation, to Higher Dynamics, emphasizing explosive movements and nervous system priming.

ex.note:
-- GENERAL DYNAMICS --
[Shoes off]

10yd

~ Step through and pull knee a little deeper towards chest each rep

10yd

~ Pump the arms, get knees up high, keep chest up
~ As many reps as possible, land softly w/ each step

10yd

~ Push hips forward every rep to increase the stretch with a pause each step

10yd

~ Fire the hamstrings, land softly, pump arms
** Pull foot to glute

10yd

~ Grab ankle and pull leg across so the foot moves toward opposite hip
~ Keep chest lifted the whole time, avoid dipping down
** Increase ROM each rep

10yd

~ Avoid dropping chest down
~ Activate lower abs to lift leg as close to hip height as possible
** Increase ROM each rep

10yd

~ Focus on a good stretch and hip mobilization 
~ Drop back knee down low with each step
** Biggest step each rep

10yd

~ Put hands on hips, focus on balance and coordination
~ Eliminate the “stutter step” between each rep
** Focus is not on size of step, instead balance

(7:10)
10yd

~ Open feet up at 45 deg.
~ Push hips back as far as possible, sink down onto each foot
~ Drive through whole foot when standing
~ Cross over when stepping into the next one

10yd

~ Pull toes toward shin
~ Fully extend leg out in front, dive chest down to stretch hamstring and low back
** Keep back flat

~ Interlace fingers behind head
~ Keep chest upright

(8:21) 5e

~ Lift opposite foot off the ground and arm over head 
~ Sink hips back, reach opposite hand down to touch opposite toes
~ Fully reach back overhead each rep, switch sides
** Keep back flat

-- HIGHER DYNAMICS --
[Shoes on]
(0:17)

- 10yd: Lateral R

- 10yd: Lateral L

~ Knees wide & over ankle entire time
~ Short, choppy steps

- 10yd: L
- 10yd: R

~ Face feet forward, hips square
~ Explode with reach foot directly under

[Shoes off]
(2:19)
10yd

~ Stab heel into ground, shift forward to ball of foot and push off
~ Keep back foot on ball until next heel accepts force
** Controlled manner

(2:37)
10yd

~ Same thing here
** Now a fluid motion

(3:00)
10yd

~ Keep knees and hips soft, flex them
** Controlled motion

SL: 10e
- 5x pause at top 
- 5x explosive

~ Imagine a glass of water on the back
~ Keep ankle cocked and calf parallel to the ground

SL: 10e
- 5x pause at top 
- 5x fluid

~ Extend leg all the way behind with each rep
~ Keep ankle cocked
** Extend ROM each rep

[Shoes on]
* Use small loop band

- 10yd: Forward

- 10yd: Backward

- 10yd: L

- 10yd: R

~ Knees wide & over ankle entire time
~ Short, choppy steps

ss.note:
[Shoes off]
(6:23 - 7:33)

- 10yd: Toe Down

- 10yd: Toe Up (Dorsiflexion)

- 10yd: Pulsing (Every other)

- 10yd: Alternating Feet

- 10yd: 5yd R / 5yd L
10yd back after each Pogo set

-- GENERAL DYNAMICS --
[Shoes off]

10yd

~ Step through and pull knee a little deeper towards chest each rep

10yd

~ Pump the arms, get knees up high, keep chest up
~ As many reps as possible, land softly w/ each step

10yd

~ Push hips forward every rep to increase the stretch with a pause each step

10yd

~ Fire the hamstrings, land softly, pump arms
** Pull foot to glute

10yd

~ Grab ankle and pull leg across so the foot moves toward opposite hip
~ Keep chest lifted the whole time, avoid dipping down
** Increase ROM each rep

10yd

~ Avoid dropping chest down
~ Activate lower abs to lift leg as close to hip height as possible
** Increase ROM each rep

10yd

~ Focus on a good stretch and hip mobilization 
~ Drop back knee down low with each step
** Biggest step each rep

10yd

~ Put hands on hips, focus on balance and coordination
~ Eliminate the “stutter step” between each rep
** Focus is not on size of step, instead balance

(7:10)
10yd

~ Open feet up at 45 deg.
~ Push hips back as far as possible, sink down onto each foot
~ Drive through whole foot when standing
~ Cross over when stepping into the next one

10yd

~ Pull toes toward shin
~ Fully extend leg out in front, dive chest down to stretch hamstring and low back
** Keep back flat

~ Interlace fingers behind head
~ Keep chest upright

(8:21) 5e

~ Lift opposite foot off the ground and arm over head 
~ Sink hips back, reach opposite hand down to touch opposite toes
~ Fully reach back overhead each rep, switch sides
** Keep back flat

10yd

10yd

10yd

~ Keep ankle cocked and calf parallel to the ground

SL: 10e

~ Extend leg all the way behind with each rep
~ Keep ankle cocked
** Extend ROM each rep
